title: Owl with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x="10" y="82" width="80" height="7" rx="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <rect x="10" y="82" width="80" height="3" rx="2" fill="#A8724A"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="28" ry="26" fill="#7B4F2E"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="18" ry="18" fill="#D4A56B"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#F0D8A8"/>
  <!-- feather texture on belly -->
  <path d="M42 62 Q46 66 42 70" stroke="#C49558" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M58 62 Q54 66 58 70" stroke="#C49558" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M46 74 Q50 78 54 74" stroke="#C49558" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="60" rx="10" ry="20" fill="#6B4226" transform="rotate(-10 22 60)"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="60" rx="10" ry="20" fill="#6B4226" transform="rotate(10 78 60)"/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <polygon points="30,34 26,20 38,30" fill="#6B4226"/>
  <polygon points="70,34 74,20 62,30" fill="#6B4226"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#7B4F2E"/>
  <!-- eyebrow tufts -->
  <polygon points="28,32 32,24 38,32" fill="#A8724A"/>
  <polygon points="72,32 68,24 62,32" fill="#A8724A"/>
  <!-- face disc -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#C49558"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#E0C090"/>
  <!-- eyes outer -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="9" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="9" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- eyes inner -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="6" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="6" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="3.5" fill="#2D1B00"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="3.5" fill="#2D1B00"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <polygon points="37,37 38,35 39,37 38,39" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="57,37 58,35 59,37 58,39" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="43" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="43" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points="46,48 54,48 50,56" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <polygon points="46,48 54,48 50,52" fill="#FFD080"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="86" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="86" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <line x1="36" y1="86" x2="44" y2="86" stroke="#E09030" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="86" x2="64" y2="86" stroke="#E09030" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- stars around -->
  <polygon points="15,20 16.5,16 18,20 16.5,24" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <polygon points="85,15 86.5,11 88,15 86.5,19" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <polygon points="8,45 9.5,41 11,45 9.5,49" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <polygon points="92,48 93.5,44 95,48 93.5,52" fill="#FFE066"/>
</svg>
